notes: Cross-verse split: the supplied English case preposition governing a Greek verb's bare case complement. This chapter puts such a preposition on the governed word in every other unit (10:9, 10:11, 10:12, 10:13, 10:14, 10:17, 10:18, 10:20, 10:21, 10:22, 10:24, 10:25, 10:28, 10:34, 10:35, 10:36, 10:37, 10:41, 10:42), and 10:30 alone gave *among* to the verb while leaving `λῃσταῖς` bare. The unit's own note licenses the correction, saying *among* answers to the dative. Nothing else in the verse changes.
